rows.text: Item dated July 5, 1997: King Fahd 'today issued royal decree number A/63' increasing the Consultative Council to ninety members in addition to the Chairman by amending Article 3; the decree recites 'the two royal decrees A/90 and A/91 dated 27/8/1412 H (March 1, 1992)'.
rows.locator: Item KING FAHD ANNOUNCES EXPANSION OF SHURA COUNCIL

rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: Item dated July 6, 1997: King Fahd sent a letter to 'Chairman of the Shura Council Sheikh Muhammad Ibn Ibrahim Ibn Jubair' on the end of the Council's first term and the formation of the second, and the Chairman 'today presided over the final meeting of the fourth session of the first four-year term'.
rows.locator: Item SHURA COUNCIL ENDS FIRST FOUR-YEAR TERM

rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: Item dated July 6, 1997: decree A/90 'extends for a period of four years, as from 3/3/1418 H (July 7, 1997)' the ministerial-level appointments of listed officials, including 'Sheikh Muhammad Ibn Jubair as Chairman of the Shura Council'.
rows.locator: Item ROYAL DECREES ON MINISTERIAL AND TOP-LEVEL APPOINTMENTS, decree A/90

rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: Decree A/90 extends the listed ministerial-level appointments, including 'Sheikh Muhammad Ibn Jubair as Chairman of the Shura Council', 'for a period of four years, as from 3/3/1418 H (July 7, 1997)'.
rows.locator: Item ROYAL DECREES ON MINISTERIAL AND TOP-LEVEL APPOINTMENTS, decree A/90

rows.printed_name: Muhammad Ibn Ibrahim Ibn Uthman Ibn Jubair
rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: Item dated July 6, 1997: King Fahd 'today issued royal decree number A/72 announcing, effective from 3/3/1418 H (July 7, 1997), the composition' of the Council with a Chairman and ninety members for a term of four years from the end of the current period of the Council; the list begins 'Sheikh Muhammad Ibn Ibrahim Ibn Uthman Ibn Jubair (Chairman of the Shura Council)'.
rows.locator: Item ROYAL DECREE ON APPOINTMENTS TO SHURA COUNCIL, opening sentence and first entry

rows.text: Under A/72 the composition of the second council, a Chairman and ninety members, takes effect 'from 3/3/1418 H (July 7, 1997)', for a term of four years from the end of the current period of the Council.
rows.locator: Item ROYAL DECREE ON APPOINTMENTS TO SHURA COUNCIL, opening sentence

rows.text: The same A/72 item says the Council then ending had been 'formed by royal decree number A/16 dated 3/3/1414 H (August 20, 1993)'.
rows.locator: Item ROYAL DECREE ON APPOINTMENTS TO SHURA COUNCIL, opening sentence
